before.gate: answers=composition AND parts sum to a whole AND total=printed as a centre figure
before.prose: beats chart-pie (48, "composition, no centre figure, ≤ 5 parts") whenever the total is worth printing, and beats it on nothing else; yields to chart-stacked-area (64, "composition over time") when the split MOVES.

after.gate: answers=composition AND parts sum to a whole AND total=printed as a centre figure AND span.cols ≤ 6
after.prose: beats chart-pie (48, "composition, no centre figure, ≤ 5 parts") whenever the total is worth printing, and beats it on nothing else; yields to chart-stacked-area (64, "composition over time") when the split MOVES. A ring does not stretch with its tile (ds-030), so it takes a half-width column and never a full-width row (s305-D9).

before.gate: answers=change-over-time AND series 1–5 on ONE continuous time axis AND axes=present AND span.cols ≥ 6

after.gate: records >= 2 AND needs in (sort, filter, select, edit)
after.prose: the record-list for rows the person works on as a set: it beats list-items (the role's default, s274-D6) whenever sorting, filtering, selecting or editing is required, and yields to list-items when needs = none.

states.name: no-filters
states.shows: the total count and a `No filters applied` hint; no chip row, no clear-all.

states.name: filtered
states.shows: `N of M`, the chip row (with `+N more` past the overflow threshold), and clear-all.

states.name: loading
states.shows: a skeleton where the count sits — the count's POSITION is held so the row does not jump — plus the word `Updating results`, announced through `role=status`/`aria-live=polite`/`aria-busy`. Chips dim but stay interactive; the controls are never disabled, because a filter you cannot change while it is running is a trap.

states.name: empty
states.shows: `0 of M`, the chips that produced the zero (so the user can see what to remove), and a message block with a bell glyph, a title, a sentence and a `Clear all filters` action.

states.name: error
states.shows: an em-dash where the count would be — never a stale number presented as fresh — and a message block in rag/error-ink carrying an error triangle AND a text title AND a sentence saying nothing was changed, plus `Try again`. Colour is the third channel, never the only one (1.4.1).

chipStates: removing (max-width collapse, then removed from the DOM and the tab order)
before.$note: The five states are mutually exclusive and CSS-selected; nothing is toggled by script except the one attribute.

before.gate: records >= 2 AND the records are the same kind, each read ACROSS its own row AND surface in (none, bordered-per-record)
before.prose: surface ALONE decides the container (s274-D1): unbordered ⇒ simple-list (one line per record) or structured-list (aligned fields); a bordered surface drawn around EACH record ⇒ card-list. Actions are a ROW property, allowed in any of the three, so they decide nothing. No field count, row count or column count gates this (s274-D4): the comparison test decides — if a field must be read DOWN a column across records, it is a table, not a list. A list-level heading is OPTIONAL on all three containers (s274-D5); a per-card title is a ROW field, distinct from the list heading. Beats table (roles.json when: "default, read-mostly") and data-grid (when: "sort / filter / select / edit-in-place is required") whenever each record is read across its own row; yields to timeline (when: "time is the structure, records have happened") and to tree (when: "records nest").

the person must stop: confirm a consequential action, or finish a task that cannot share the screen; yields to split-button when interrupts = none AND actions >= 2 (one main action with a few related ones beside it), and to dropdown when interrupts = none AND options >= 5 (one choice from a list, made in place, s270-D1).
